questions.question:
8 is related to 93 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 10 is related to 117. To which of the following is 14 related, following the same logic?

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g., 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.solution:
**Logic followed:**

First number × 12 - 3 = Second number.

Given:

8 is related to 93.

8 × 12 - 3 = 96 - 3 = 93.

10 is related to 117.

10 × 12 - 3 = 120 - 3 = 117.

similarly for 14:

14 × 12 - 3 = 168 - 3 = 165.

**14 is related to 165.**

Hence the correct answer is** "Option 3"**

**Statements:**

Some cups are glasses.

No cup is a plate.

**Conclusions:**

(i) No glass is a plate.

(ii) Some glasses are not cups.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

questions.solution:
Statements:

Some cups are glasses.

No cup is a plate.

Possible venn diagram is,

Conclusions:

(i) No glass is a plate. → Not Follow ( As there is no direct link between glass and plate)

(ii) Some glasses are not cups.→ Not Follow ( As some cups are glasses, so we can't say that some glass are not cup).

questions.question:
What will come in the place of '?' in the following equation, if '+' and '−' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged ?

56 − 33 × 3 ÷ 4 + 36 = ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

56 − 33 × 3 ÷ 4 + 36 = ?

**Formula used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f1710fa97d539a5235dc336f2c1506ded41be01aa281a056a3ac297c9bedd539.png] 

**Calculations:**

After interchanging the operators '+' and '−' and also '×' and '÷' .

56 + __33 ÷ 3__ × 4 - 36 

⇒ 56 + __11 ____×____ 4__ - 36 

⇒ 56 + 44 - 36 = 64

Hence the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
